Lemon Rice

Prep Time: 10 mins Servings: Yield: 4 bowls Source: Example Kitchen

1 cup rice

2 cups stock

Instructions Checklist

Simmer the rice in stock until tender.

Finish with lemon zest.

Quick Beans

Cook Time: 20 mins Source: Example Kitchen

2 cans black beans

1 teaspoon cumin

Stir the beans and cumin together; simmer for 20 minutes.
